description: Run shellcheck and return structured diagnostics with file, line, column, message, and SC rule code. Much more compact than raw shellcheck output. Use minSeverity to filter by severity level.

detailLevel.description: Item preset: summary 20, normal 100, full (default; also skips the response budget)

files.description: Required. Shell script path(s) to lint; a string or array

minSeverity.description: Minimum severity to include (e.g. 'error' drops warnings and info)

name: bash_lint
title: Bash lint (structured)
